subject: Startups
title: The Sean Ellis Test
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Sean Ellis Test usable.

hook.text: Ask users: 'How would you feel if you could no longer use this product?' If 40% say 'very disappointed,' you've won.

buildup.text: Sean Ellis created this survey as a proxy for product-market fit. It's one question with three answer choices.

discovery.text: Below 40% 'very disappointed' means the product is nice-to-have, not a must-have. You haven't nailed it yet.

twist.text: Slack hit 51% on the Ellis test before its public launch. That signal gave the team confidence to go big.

climax.text: The test is cheap, fast, and brutally honest. One question can save months of building the wrong thing.

punchline.text: One question: 'Would you miss us?' The answer is everything.

quiz.question: What threshold indicates product-market fit in the Sean Ellis test?
